# Serge Garcia

<div class="lead"><strong>Senior Researcher at INRAE</strong> and member of BETA in Nancy. I study environmental and natural resource management through microeconomic theory and applied econometrics, with a particular focus on forests, ecosystem services, biodiversity and water.</div>

<div class="home-intro">
My research asks how economic analysis can help understand and govern <strong>socio-ecological systems</strong>. I am especially interested in how private decisions, ecosystem dynamics and public policy interact, and in the design of instruments that can reconcile environmental objectives with heterogeneous behaviours and incentives.
</div>

## Research

::: {.research-lines}
::: {.research-line}
<div class="line-number">01</div>
<div>
### Valuing ecosystems and natural capital
Economic valuation of ecosystem services and biodiversity, non-market preferences, and the role of natural capital in production and welfare.
</div>
:::

::: {.research-line}
<div class="line-number">02</div>
<div>
### Understanding behaviour and heterogeneity
Decisions by forest owners, managers, citizens and users; discrete choices, social interactions, risk, information and spatial heterogeneity.
</div>
:::

::: {.research-line}
<div class="line-number">03</div>
<div>
### Designing environmental policies and incentives
Payments for environmental services, contracts, conservation mechanisms and public policies for sustainable and multifunctional resource management.
</div>
:::
:::

[Explore my research →](research.qmd)

::: {.grid-2}
::: {.card .project-card}
<div class="kicker">Scientific community</div>
### FAERE
President of the **French Association of Environmental and Resource Economists** since 2023.
:::

::: {.card .project-card}
<div class="kicker">Forest socio-ecological systems</div>
### OLEF & ARTEMIS
Scientific Director of the **Observatory for the Economy of the Forest (OLEF)** and member of the executive board of the interdisciplinary **ARTEMIS** programme.
:::

::: {.card .project-card}
<div class="kicker">Research & public policy</div>
### PERCEVAL
Coordinator of the TETRAE project on the supply, social demand and valuation mechanisms for forest ecosystem services in Grand Est.
:::

::: {.card .project-card}
<div class="kicker">Collective expertise</div>
### Forest diversification & ANSES
Co-leader of the INRAE collective scientific assessment on **forest diversification** and expert in socio-economic analysis at **ANSES**.
:::
:::
